trend.bull: last completed daily close > EMA and EMA > its value 20 observed days ago
trend.availability: daily bar end <= completed signal bar end

execution: v3 runner unchanged; eligible entry on original start event only; ALL original opposite starts remain exits even if reverse entry is rejected; trend flips alone neither close nor open trades

matched_controls.anchors: executed candidate trades from replayed base long-only policy, not small-account subset
matched_controls.matching: same UTC calendar month, America/New_York hour, causal daily regime; relative ATR14/price within 25 percent of anchor; exclude original long and short starts; no repeated entry bar within a schedule
matched_controls.schedule: one random eligible control bar per matchable anchor, outcome-blind seeded sampling; draw schedule before replay; original short signals remain exits; one position at a time; overlaps suppress entries
matched_controls.missing: report unmatched anchors and candidates; no relaxed matching fallback
matched_controls.interpretation: conditional diagnostic of entry timing under shared classifier exit policy, not independent deployable random strategy; future-aware matching to observed trade distribution, not a causal trading rule

decision: Descriptive decomposition and paired monthly differences versus baseline. No economic-causality, pristine holdout or live-promotion verdict. If bearish-trend shorts have little support, answer is inconclusive rather than short edge disproven. Controls are a 20-schedule diagnostic, not a calibrated significance test.
forbidden: optimizing EMA, slope, timeframe, stops or classifier
merging into main or placing orders
